name: io.github.sepehr071/snappshop-mcp
title: Snapp! Shop
description: Read-only Snapp! Shop marketplace: search, categories, seller offers in Toman, reviews.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPPSHOP_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Iranian HTTP proxy URL for the Snapp! Shop requests (the site blocks foreign IPs); system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
